args.title: Fix Toast component accessibility and auto-dismiss behavior for errors
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update the Toast component to handle error toasts separately from informational toasts. Error toasts should use role='alert' and aria-live='assertive' and should not auto-dismiss after 5000ms, remaining on screen until the user explicitly dismisses them.
